鈴川"My wife and daughter. Those beautiful faces growing sick, wasting away. Mouths that had always given me warm words, giving me nothing but gasps of pain. Right before my eyes, and I could do nothing."

鈴川"Hope! I could not throw hope away! That there was a savior in this world, that mercy would come down to us!"
鈴川"...If humanity is cursed, isn't hope the final stroke? An iron shackle, to keep the prisoner from escaping the rack."
鈴川"But no more regrets. I will not have that hope a second time."
鈴川"This is the reign of malice. Beautiful things will be lost. There is no way to protect them to the end. Therefore—"
鈴川"All you beautiful things I love. With these hands, I will destroy you."
